name: Introducing Yourself at a Networking Event
equipment: A notebook and a colleague or mirror to practice speaking aloud
instructions: This lesson focuses on introducing yourself at a networking event -- practice these key phrases out loud:
Hi, I'm Alex -- I work in product marketing over at Northwind.
Great to meet you -- what brings you to this event?
I'd love to hear more about what you're working on.
Here's my card -- would love to stay in touch.
Try using at least two of these phrases in a short role-play scenario at work.
